decisions.reason: As a men’s care line built on the firm’s existing natural-cosmetics know-how, it is close enough to the core business that management would usually keep it and try to learn from the launch, though the niche positioning and lack of visible R&D signals raise some risk of discontinuation.

As a facial cleansing foam explicitly extending an existing Sandorini series, it fits the firm’s established knowledge base very well, so management is likely to retain it and refine it rather than withdraw it.
